Hello,
Would it be possible to cancel this order?
My situation has changed and I don't think this is the right miner for me
at this time.

Hello,

Sorry to hear your situation has changed. Could you reply with your order number (it looks like Shop····)? Without it I can't pull up the right order, and I'd rather give you real details than guesses.

Here's where I can start. If the unit hasn't shipped yet, it isn't sitting on a shelf waiting; it's been allocated to you and is being built for you, so cancelling isn't the first thing I'd point you to. Two things I can do myself as soon as I have the order number: keep the full value you paid as store credit on your account, usable on anything we have in stock now, or swap the order to a different miner that fits you better, with the exact difference quoted to you before I change anything.

Send me the number and I'll come back to you today with the ship date on your order and both options priced out.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hello,

Thank you for the order number. I've pulled up Shop····, the Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s) with the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA, $681.97, paid and not shipped. The B.4 is scheduled to ship October 31.

Your cancellation and refund request is with a supervisor for review, as you were told in the chat, and I've put the order on hold on our side so nothing goes out while they look at it. I can't confirm the outcome or a date for you myself, but a colleague is on it today and will come back to you in this thread.

One thing I can put in front of you before they do. If you'd rather keep the order, we can refund $50 of it back to your original payment and you keep the BS-4 shipping on October 31. Just say the word and I'll put that to the team for approval. If a different miner would suit you better than the BS-4, I can swap the order to it directly and tell you the exact difference first, and keeping the full value as store credit on your account is also open to you.

If none of that works for you, that's completely fine, the cancellation request stays where it is.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
